description: Withhold VAT from this supplier's invoices. Only takes effect if this company is itself a KRA-Appointed VAT Withholding Agent (Kenyan Accountant Settings) -- configurable per supplier since a company can be selective about which suppliers this applies to.
label: Subject to VAT Withholding (WVAT)
name: Supplier-royce_subject_to_vat_withholding

description: This customer withholds tax (WHT and/or VAT) before paying invoices -- typically a parastatal or other KRA-gazetted withholding agent. When flagged, recording a Payment Entry against them offers to record the withheld amount as a recoverable credit instead of a shortfall. Configurable per customer, including turning it off for one that's exempted.
label: Withholds Tax From Us (e.g. Parastatal)
name: Customer-royce_withholds_tax_from_us
